versions.changelog:
- Updates compatibility and usage instructions to require the new cargo-project skill and project structure (cargo.json), replacing cargo-cdk.
- Updates documentation and CLI commands throughout to use cargo-ai project [add|init|plan] instead of cargo-ai cdk.
- Enhances and clarifies setup/installation, audit, and adaptation steps in SKILL.md, README.md, and reference docs.
- Removes obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- Updates references and instructions across evaluation and configuration files to align with the new Cargo project flow.

crm-deduplication v0.1.2

- Updated documentation for greater clarity, improved instructions, and revised usage examples.
- SKILL.md version updated and minor wording enhancements for a more concise description.
- Internal references and guidance clarified to streamline setup and review.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Adds first-class contact deduplication alongside account deduplication; supports deduplicating both companies and people in CRM.
- Introduces parallel account and contact deduplication paths, each with their own model, policy, play, and approval process.
- Updates policies, actions, and play logic to include LinkedIn URL, person ID, exact email, and phone for deduping contacts.
- Refines and expands audits, contract checks, configuration, and documentation for both deduplication paths.
- Updates project integration and setup steps so you can select accounts, contacts, or both and follow tailored approval and deployment for each.

Initial release of crm-deduplication: automate and safeguard deduplication of company accounts directly in your CRM.

- Audits company identifiers and duplicate candidate classes before any write action.
- Builds a recurring, disabled deduplication play on existing CRM models (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio supported).
- Automatically merges only exact LinkedIn ID matches with no identity conflicts; all others routed for Human Review via Slack.
- Provides detailed operator guidance and approval checkpoints through four phases: audit, build, run, and verify.
- Includes clear install, adaptation, and deployment instructions for integrating into Cargo CDK projects.
- Recommends crm-enrichment if identifier coverage is weak, but operates independently.
